changes.title: Analysis metadata or lineage definition change
changes.description: Illustrative change to the v0.18 analysis-dataset metadata scope, variable labels/types/roles, origin/derivation rules, source-reference lineage, Define-XML reference package or deterministic XML-export rule.
changes.rationale: Tests whether a metadata-definition change forces review of the controlled metadata specification/documentation, all described analysis datasets, executable lineage QC and Define-XML-inspired export without inventing a TLF or altering efficacy/safety inferential families.
